en.sayyid-mohsen-al-husayni-al-milani: 10. My father, ‘Ali ibn Ḥusain, and (my brother) ‘Ali ibn Muḥammad ibn Qūlawayh all narrated to me from ‘Ali ibn Ibrāhīm ibn Hāshim, from his father, from Ibn Abī ‘Umayr, from Zayd Al-Narsi, who said: Abul Ḥasan, Mūsā ibn Ja’far (Imam Kāżim (a.s.)) said:
Those who go to the Ziyārah of this son of mine – and pointed to Abil Ḥasan Al-Riďā (a.s.) – will be rewarded with Paradise.
